notes.title: Code Zodiac is out now!
notes.content:
Today is the official release of Code Zodiac!

Code Zodiac is the result of over two years of nights-and-weekends work. I'm incredibly proud of where it stands today.

When I started this game, I set out to pay respects to the handheld adventure games I played as a kid. The stories were big, the colors were bright, and the characters were cool. For me, at least, Code Zodiac recaptures those elements. And it delivers them through a short experience that you can finish in one or two sittings.

I've done my best to build an engaging world, cool characters, and surprising set pieces to make the player smile, without ever bogging them down. The combat is straight-forward. The Zodiac bosses are unique. And the music, courtesy of my friend Noah Camp, is top-notch.

I hope you'll give Code Zodiac a try.

Thank you for playing.

- Morgan
